numerical_approval.change: Extend maximum shift from +/-12 to +/-24 semitones; other plan numerical targets accepted

measurement.onset_definition: first source-active sample, not first tracker output
measurement.settling_definition: time the 20 ms within-tolerance dwell completes; never backdate to its beginning
measurement.uncertain_reference_policy: exclude from accuracy denominator; report separately, never count as correct
measurement.confidence_interval: Wilson 95% for frame proportions; descriptive only for correlated frames
measurement.pitch_analysis: independent offline normalized-autocorrelation estimate; not the product tracker or human ground truth
measurement.formant_analysis: fixed-band spectral peaks on synthetic broadband resonators only; not real high-F0 formant ground truth

listening.level_policy: draft: common source-derived RMS gain per trial across all candidate stems; never normalize each harmony separately; no clipping/limiting
listening.mix_policy: fixed dry lead plus three equally gained harmonies; identical optional backing for every candidate, no masking EQ or repair
listening.timing_policy: overall-delay alignment allowed only for timbre trials; native timing for response trials
listening.blind_policy: administrator-held opaque labels, balanced subsets, hidden duplicates and a degraded anchor; no transformed perfect reference
listening.critical: unsafe burst, reproducible wrong target, missing syllable, or stuck output confirmed independently by two listeners
